text:
Jordan: Quick thread \u2014 I'm drafting an RFC about multi-region "safety lattice": classify behaviours by (consent, affinity, consistency). Sketch: https://redwood/internal/multisite/safety_lattice.png
Maya: Nice framing. What's the immediate ask? proto + runbook examples?
Jordan: Yes. Need: (1) clear lease proto, (2) per-class degradation semantics, (3) test cases.
Liam: For affinity: default active/active w/ prefer-local hint. Add tenant-level "require-local" that blocks failover.
Sara: Consent: residency tenants must never have raw payloads replicated. For those, fallback -> http 429 + X-Redwood-RouteHint.
Nina: Observability: add span.attr tenant.residency and trace tag site.origin; metric cross_site_fallback{tenant,from,to,reason}.
Ethan: Operator preflight: block cutovers if migrations>0 in last 15m or prefetch queue not drained. ops-bot should enforce.
Maya: Lease proto sketch: Acquire(tenant_id, preferred_site, ttl_ms, idempotency_key) -> (holder_site, expires_at_ms, lease_token).
Liam: Conflict appendix: inference requests idempotent by request_id; metadata=merge-CRDT; billing=append-only with event dedupe.
Jordan: Tests: site kill (residency tenants must not cross), burst failover (ensure route-hints), leader-loss (no split-primary). I'll convert this into the RFC draft and tag owners.
ops-bot: [policy] gate created: `no_migrations_last_15m`
